data.name: Aadilat
data.gender_notes: Aadilat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fair, Just, Righteous. The name Aadilat carries the meaning “Just” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aadilat usually hope their child will grow to embody just and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of justice and fairness in the world.
data.etymology: Aadilat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Just.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadilat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عديلات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني العادلة أو المتساوية في الحق والعدل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'عديلات' مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-د-ل' والذي يعني العدل والمساواة. يشير الاسم إلى الشخصية التي تتميز بالعدالة والإنصاف، وهي صفة محمودة في الإسلام. يعتبر الاسم من الأسماء التي تعبر عن القيم الأخلاقية العالية.

in_urdu.name: عدیلات
in_urdu.meaning: عدیلات کا مطلب ہے عادلہ یا حق و عدل میں برابر
in_urdu.long_meaning: عدیلات نام عربی جڑ 'ع-د-ل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عدل اور مساوات۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو عدالت اور انصاف کی خصوصیت رکھتی ہیں، جو اسلامی اقدار میں انتہائی قابل تعریف ہے۔ یہ نام اعلیٰ اخلاقی اقدار کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अदीलात
in_hindi.meaning: अदीलात का अर्थ है अदिल या अधिकार और न्याय में समान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अदीलात नाम अरबी मूल 'ع-د-ल' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है न्याय और समानता। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो न्याय और निष्पक्षता की विशेषता रखते हैं, जो इस्लामी मूल्यों में अत्यधिक प्रशंसनीय है। यह नाम उच्च नैतिक मूल्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

in_english.name: Aadilat
in_english.meaning: Aadilat means fair, just, or equal in rights and justice
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aadilat is derived from the Arabic root 'ع-د-ل' (aad-ala), which signifies justice, fairness, and equality. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with individuals who embody the values of justice and righteousness. Aadilat reflects high moral standards and is often chosen for its positive connotations of integrity and balance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aadilat" holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world, where justice and fairness are fundamental values that are highly regarded. The name embodies the idea of a person who upholds these values and strives to deliver fair and equal treatment to all, regardless of their background, socio-economic status, or ethnicity. In many Muslim communities, the name "Aadilat" is often given to a child as a reminder to act justly and to strive for fairness in their actions, contributing to a more socially just and equitable world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Aadilat" holds deep significance in Islam, reflecting the moral virtue of being righteous and just. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Allah is pleased with three and displeased with three: He is pleased with a person who is sincere in intention, acts justly, and speaks the truth, and He is displeased with a person who is insincere in intention, acts unjustly, and speaks a lie." (Sahih Muslim). In this context, the name "Aadilat" represents an individual who strives to embody this virtue and live a life that is pleasing to Allah. Through one's actions, words, and intentions, they seek to uphold justice and fairness, not only in their dealings with others but also in their relationship with their Creator. Ultimately, the name "Aadilat" serves as a constant reminder for the bearer to continually work towards being a righteous and just individual, both in this world and in the hereafter.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Just" symbolizes Fair, Just, Righteous. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aadilat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of just.
